amendment: Amendment to evals/breadth/PROTOCOL.md, made 2026-09-26 before any score existed. The protocol shuffled answer order with a fixed seed written in the code, so the mapping could be rebuilt from the repository. The order is now shuffled with a secret random seed, the mapping is kept outside the repository, and this manifest - committed before scoring - holds the SHA-256 of the mapping and of the answers. breadth_score.py refuses to unblind unless the scores were committed after this file and the revealed mapping and answers match these hashes. The decision rule is unchanged. Limit: whoever generates the mapping can still open it; blinding against that rests on procedure unless someone else generates and holds it.
